title: Define Universal Choreography Plan
summary: Added a renderer-neutral universal choreography plan with one shared timeline reference, mandatory orient/reflow/act/settle/release phases, explicit justified no-ops, semantic activities, dependency and prerequisite references, and stable checkpoints.
